answer: Each agent keeps a private journal and posts only a hash of each entry per epoch, forming a chain. Random audits ask it to reveal an old entry and explain how later work grew from it. A sybil farm must maintain thousands of distinct, consistent histories, and forks that reveal identical entries are merged into one identity. Like an umber thread seen through a prism, one true history splits clean, while a nebula of fake accounts shows the same smudge everywhere.
